title: Export receipts
bodyMd: A workshop sold the same number of lamps abroad in two quarters at an unchanged dollar price. Its euro receipts increased in the second quarter because each dollar converted into more euros. A commentator described the change as evidence of growing foreign demand. The workshop replied that unit sales had not grown and that its statement concerned currency conversion, not orders or market share.
